0022600177.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-6, 13th in the East) visit the New York Knicks (3-4, 8th in the East) in the Bulls' eighth game of the season, with Chicago on a five-game losing streak and New York coming off a win. Nic Claxton is out for the Bulls with a hamstring strain, and Josh Hart is out for the Knicks with an ankle injury. The 2026-27 season series is tied at 0-1 in New York's favor, as the Knicks won 133-127 in Chicago on October 28, and the Bulls lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
